domain_symbols.symbolic: symbolic expressions used by this domain

rules.name: Qubit state normalization
rules.operation: Pure single-qubit states are unit vectors in C^2.
counterexamples: Non-normalized states do not encode valid probabilities

rules.name: Hadamard gate action
rules.operation: Apply the Hadamard gate to create equal superposition or rotate between computational and Hadamard bases.
examples: H^{\otimes n}|0..0> produces uniform superposition over all n-bit strings
counterexamples: H is not a Pauli gate

rules.name: CNOT entangler
rules.operation: Flip target conditioned on control to create entanglement when control is in superposition.
counterexamples: CNOT alone is not universal; needs single-qubit non-Clifford

rules.name: Born rule
rules.input_form: state |psi>, projector P_m onto outcome m
rules.operation: Compute the probability of measurement outcome m on state |psi>.
examples: Measuring |+> in Z basis gives Pr(0)=Pr(1)=1/2
counterexamples: Non-projective POVMs use generalized E_m operators

rules.name: No-cloning theorem
rules.output_form: no unitary U with U|psi>|0> = |psi>|psi> for all |psi>
rules.operation: Prove that perfect cloning of arbitrary quantum states is impossible by linearity.
examples: Foundation of quantum key distribution security
counterexamples: Known orthogonal states can be copied
common_errors: Confusing approximate cloning with perfect cloning

rules.name: Quantum Fourier transform
rules.output_form: QFT|x> = (1/sqrt(N)) sum_k exp(2 pi i x k / N) |k>
rules.operation: Apply the discrete Fourier transform as a unitary on n qubits in O(n^2) gates.
counterexamples: Classical FFT is O(N log N); QFT amplitudes are not directly observable
common_errors: Trying to read out all amplitudes by single measurement

rules.name: Grover iteration amplitude
rules.input_form: marked fraction a, iteration count k
preconditions: Oracle marks fraction a of N items
rules.operation: Amplify marked-item probability with O(sqrt(N/M)) oracle queries.
counterexamples: Too many iterations overshoots and reduces success probability
common_errors: Using k that maximizes amplitude only for known M

rules.name: Shor period finding
rules.input_form: function f(x) = a^x mod N with unknown period r
rules.output_form: r recovered from QFT peaks with high probability
rules.operation: Use QFT on superpositions of f to factor N in polynomial time.
examples: Breaks RSA at large enough qubit count
counterexamples: Smooth N has classical polynomial algorithms
common_errors: Confusing logical and physical qubit requirements

rules.name: Bell inequality (CHSH)
rules.operation: Distinguish local hidden variable theories from quantum mechanics via correlation bounds.
examples: Singlet state achieves Tsirelson bound 2 sqrt(2)
counterexamples: Detection-loophole experiments may admit local explanations
common_errors: Mixing CHSH conventions with different operator signs

rules.name: Surface code threshold
rules.input_form: physical error rate p per gate, code distance d
rules.operation: Exponentially suppress logical errors by increasing code distance below threshold.
examples: d=11 surface code can reach 10^-9 logical error from 10^-3 physical
counterexamples: Above threshold, increasing d makes errors worse

rules.name: Quantum teleportation
rules.input_form: unknown state |psi>, Bell pair shared between A and B
rules.output_form: B reconstructs |psi> after 2 classical bits from A
rules.operation: Transmit a qubit state using entanglement and 2 classical bits without violating no-cloning.
counterexamples: No FTL signaling: classical channel still needed
common_errors: Believing the state can be reconstructed without the classical bits

rules.name: Variational quantum eigensolver
rules.operation: Hybrid classical-quantum loop minimizing expectation to estimate ground-state energy on NISQ hardware.
examples: Used for small molecules (H2, LiH) on near-term devices
counterexamples: Barren plateaus prevent gradient training in deep random ansatze
common_errors: Reporting expectation values without statistical shot-noise estimates
